description: This Java source file defines the GenericHelperFactory class responsible for creating and caching instances of GenericHelper based on datasource configurations in the OFBiz framework. It includes mechanisms for dynamic class loading, reflection-based instantiation, and thread-safe caching.

classes.name: GenericHelperFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and caching GenericHelper instances based on datasource configuration.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached instance of GenericHelper based on the provided helperInfo, performing dynamic class loading and reflection to instantiate the helper.
